acceptance: Every figure in INSIGHTS.md sections 4-6 is computed from recorded data with a plain definition (fixture tests).
Speed to lead counts only opening hours and skips holidays and estimated first contacts (tests incl. DST).
Win rate uses when leads closed (Lead.closedAt); leads with no known close date are left out and the definition says so.
Rates and averages wait for 10 leads/rentals; counts always show.
Old pages redirect; /desk/customers/insights and /desk/inventory/insights do not hit the [id] pages.
OWNER/ADMIN only; job roles keep exactly today's access (tests); staff refused by every insights function.
Axe + 5 sizes and keyboard in the browser spec; ci green at the exact head; every review comment read.
invariants: Numbers only from recorded data; every figure carries its definition (glossary InfoTip). No goal, price or money rule changes.
Insights functions refuse STAFF themselves (requireRole OWNER/ADMIN first); existing growth/reports/dashboard reads gain no session checks (To do rules and cron call them).
Job-role access never widens: the two-segment map (customers/insights=management, inventory/insights=billing, money/income=billing) is checked before the first-segment map.

Lead.closedAt is set in the same transaction wherever a lead becomes CONVERTED or LOST (status change, convert, merge) and cleared on reopen; the backfill uses the newest lead.status/lead.convert audit row.
Display thresholds (MIN_LEADS/MIN_RENTALS = 10) stay code constants, not business settings.
next: AR-10 retires the redirected old pages (their files stay as redirects until then).
outcome: Insights where the owner works: Customers and Equipment gain an Insights tab (lead speed/win rate/sources, customer movement and worth-a-call lists; fleet value, flags, demand and repair gaps), the Money Overview gains rent health and goals, /desk/money/income carries the revenue ledger, and growth/fleet/revenue/reports/dashboard redirect to the new homes.
